segments.text:
V. 73.
Surely thou art alſo one of them; for thy ſpeech diſcovereth thee —Malchus might have brought a ſtronger Proof than this. But ſuch is the over-ruling Providence of GOD, that the world, in the Height of their Zeal, commonly catch hold of the very weakeſt of all Arguments againſt the Children of GOD.
